description.value: Toto Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Tsawwassen (Delta, BC) that relocated from Steveston, bringing the same quality-focused approach to its new community. The kitchen emphasizes wild sockeye salmon, premium Japanese Yamabuki sushi vinegar, roasted sea salt, and preservative-free nori. Cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen area will find a full menu spanning nigiri, sashimi, specialty rolls, teriyaki, ramen, and party trays.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 61m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at totosushi.ca is live and corroborates OSM data: phone (604) 943-3251, address 1270 56 St Delta BC V4L 2A4, and the same URL all match. The site confirms the restaurant is open and operating in Tsawwassen, notes it relocated from Steveston, and emphasizes premium, health-conscious Japanese ingredients. The gallery lists 'Tofu Teriyaki' confirming at least vegetarian options exist on the menu, consistent with OSM diet:vegetarian=yes and diet:vegan=yes tags. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM addr:street is '56 Street' but website lists the full address as '1270 56 St. Delta, BC V4L 2A4' — city and postal code are absent from OSM tags; output address uses the more complete website value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant confirmed open via live website with current copyright 2026, matching contact details, and full menu. A useful food stop for touring cyclists in Tsawwassen.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business relocated from Steveston to Tsawwassen; website tagline reads 'The cats have moved from Steveston to tsawwassen.'

wow_evidence: relocated from Steveston, bringing the same quality-focused approach
